description: Find marketing video templates for a product, project, or announcement. Prefer a marketing goal and, when project facts support it, a release moment; then add a short product or style query. Returns a searchId, the selected moment, detectedMoments hints, and results with id, title, goals, moments, aspect, length, preview MP4, poster image, and editor URL. Engine details appear only when the engine filter is used.

aspect.description: Only when the destination implies it: 9:16 vertical (Reels, TikTok, Shorts), 16:9 (YouTube, web), 1:1 or 4:5 (feeds).

engine.description: Advanced source-package filter. Omit unless the user explicitly asks for an engine.

goal.description: Marketing goal. One of: launch-product (Launch a product), announce-feature (Announce a feature), share-update (Share an update), grow-waitlist (Grow a waitlist), announce-integration (Announce an integration), announce-pricing (Announce pricing), celebrate-milestone (Celebrate a milestone), share-social-proof (Share social proof), promote-event (Promote an event), introduce-brand (Introduce a brand), run-promotion (Run a promotion), hire-team (Hire for the team).

moment.description: Release moment backed by project facts. Filters and ranks templates for it. One of: most-requested-feature (Most-requested feature shipped), generally-available (Available to everyone), limit-raised (A limit was raised or removed), faster (Something got faster), manual-step-removed (A manual step disappeared), integration-live (An integration went live), pricing-changed (Pricing changed), reliability-fix (A reliability fix landed), new-language-or-region (New language or region), new-platform (New platform), free-resource (Free tool or resource released), milestone (A real milestone was reached).

music.description: true for beat-synced templates with a generated soundtrack, false for silent ones.

purpose.description: Exact catalog purpose, for example "Product launch".

query.description: Short product or style description, for example "developer tool" or "minimal logo".

name: search_templates
title: Search video templates
